{{1981 Pacific-10 Conference football standings}}
The '''1981 Oregon State Beavers football team''' represented [[Oregon State University]] as a remember of [[Pac-12 Conference|Pacific-10 Conference]] (Pac-10) during the [[1981 NCAA Division I-A football season]]. In their second season under head coach [[Joe Avezzano]], the Beavers compiled an overall record of 1–10 record with a mark of 0–7 in conference playing, placing last in the Pac-10, and were outscored by their opponents, 469 to 145.<ref>{{cite web|title=1981 Oregon State Beavers Schedule and Results|publisher=Sports Reference LLC|work=SR/College Football|access-date=September 7, 2016|url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cfb/schools/oregon-state/1981-schedule.html}}</ref>  The team played its home games at [[Parker Stadium]] in [[Corvallis, Oregon]].
